name: Genpei Ryouran Emaki -Gikei-
source:
[b]Kanou Yoshitsune[/b] is the son of the family that runs Kanou Shrine, a shrine with ties to the Genji (Minamoto) clan. He has a younger sister named [b]Rouko[/b], and his childhood friend [b]Shizuka[/b] is the daughter of the family that runs Western Kanou Shrine, situated on the opposite shore.

One day, the three go on a school trip to Kyoto, when Rouko mysteriously disappears at Kuramadera temple. Yoshitsune and Shizuka head to Kuramadera to search for her, but when they reach the temple's main hall, they lose consciousness.

When they open their eyes, they find themselves at the same Kuramadera, yet... something is different. Though in the same location, they are approximately 850 years in the past, in the Heian period.

[From [url=https://www.nookgaming.com/kagami-games-to-release-7-visual-novels-including-sakura-moyu/]NookGaming[/url]]
translation:
[b]加纳义经[/b]是经营加纳神社家族的儿子。这座神社与源氏有着渊源。他有一位名叫[b]楼子[/b]的妹妹，青梅竹马的[b]静[/b]则是经营西加纳神社家族的女儿；西加纳神社位于河对岸。

某天，三人去京都参加修学旅行，楼子却在鞍马寺神秘失踪。义经和静前往鞍马寺寻找她，可抵达寺庙正殿后，便失去了意识。

再次睁开眼时，他们发现自己仍在同一座鞍马寺，却……有哪里不对。虽然身处同一个地方，但他们已经回到了约850年前的平安时代。
